pages.text: Use adult horses, donkeys, skeleton horses or zombie horses. Lead an available animal beside the shafts with clear footing.$(br2)Use any shaft part while holding a lead, even from a seat. Single shafts need one animal; double shafts need two. Box size, cargo and server settings determine speed.

pages.title: Two-Animal Teams
pages.text: Hitch two animals to a two-horse pole for stronger pulling power.$(br2)By default, forward and reverse acceleration increase by 20%%, and cargo's deduction from sprint speed decreases by 15%%. A fully loaded extended wagon can sprint at 1.29 times its ordinary speed, compared with 1.2 times for one animal.$(br2)Server owners can adjust these benefits.

Use shears on a hitched animal to release it and recover its lead. Restoring the wagon to blocks or dismantling it also releases animals and returns leads.$(br2)Keep safe footing near cliffs. An animal unsupported for about three seconds detaches; restoring ground contact in time keeps it hitched.
